title: Meetup for Bangalore\
description:
Its an informal meetup for designers.

The agenda includes:
1. A Talk: By an experienced designer on something generic enough to interest a majority of designers on board.

Speaker: Suvarchala Narayanan

2. A JAM: You will be given a topic and would have to come up with something based on that topic in 2 hours. This will be a group activity, the participants will be split into groups of 4-5 people.

We will have markers, sketchpens and chart papers for your use.

This event is strictly for designers. Its fine if you are a beginner and want to learn.

Cheers,
